name: MolCrafts PyTorch resolution
description: Makes every 'uv sync' in the container resolve PyTorch against the right wheel index, and exports the CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH that molnex's find_package(Torch) needs. Installs no torch itself — the project's own lockfile owns the version.

backend.description: PyTorch wheel index written to /etc/uv/uv.toml as 'torch-backend'. 'auto' lets uv pick from the CUDA driver it finds at resolve time, which is what you want when one image serves both GPU and CPU hosts.

buildIsolation.description: Keep uv's default build isolation. Set false to write 'no-build-isolation-package = ["molnex"]' into /etc/uv/uv.toml — molnex declares torch in build-system.requires, and isolation makes uv download a second full torch just to build it.
